name: Rotation assistance: a Necromancer's rotation casts Command: Undead
contract: Both Necromancer specializations put Command: Undead (504868) at 30% runic power into their priorities. Its
spell data holds only dummy effects; the minions attack through the class script. The rotation used to treat
it as a manual spell and skipped it. Expected: a level 60 Necromancer of specialization 34 with a Greater
Skeletal Warrior, Command: Undead and full runic power subscribes with the CoARotation button and selects an
enemy; the preview is Command: Undead and a press casts it.

steps.label: SETUP: the Greater Skeletal Warrior is summoned
Let the summon's global cooldown pass
DISCRIMINATING: the preview is Command: Undead
